name: Mars surface thermal-cycle qualification of bonded Honeywell PRTs for MSL (-135 to 70 C qual cycles, +125 C planetary-protection bake)
plain_name: Cycle Mars-rover temperature sensors through Martian day-night temperature swings
description: JPL qualification of Honeywell platinum resistance thermometers bonded to six substrates with four adhesives for the Mars Science Laboratory: planetary-protection cycle to +125 C for 2 h, three protoflight/qualification cycles -135 to 70 C, 1,384 summer cycles (-105 to 40 C) and 599 winter cycles (-130 to 15 C), with resistance checks.
keywords: Cycle Mars-rover temperature sensors through Martian day-night temperature swings

sources.citation: PRTs and Their Bonding for Long-Duration, Extreme-Temperature Environments (NASA Tech Briefs May 2012, NPO-47649)

requirements.rationale: Protoflight/qualification cycles -135 C to 70 C (138.15 K to 343.15 K).
Planetary-protection cycle to +125 C (398.15 K) for two hours.
Optional: PRT resistances are monitored to detect bond failures.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
